state.background: Review the plan in results/plan46/phase5/full-vitest-standard-plan.md for replacing the Batch2 production-route Playwright operations with Vitest Browser Mode standard APIs. The user's clarified purpose is to verify what this test is meant to check; reproducing the production route, SSR/Flight/hydration, network loading, real-device touch, browser zoom, or iPhone WebKit is unnecessary. The plan identifies the intended contracts as user-facing display and interaction for CpiChart, SectionTabs, ChartFilters, and SpendingBarChart, rendered through existing renderBrowserComponent into the Vitest test iframe with fixed data and viewport. It maps all 20 current Chromium route cases to existing or proposed component assertions, explicitly identifies route-only facts that will no longer be asserted, and excludes four WebKit route cases based on their overlapping SectionTabs CSS/scroll contract. It proposes Vitest page queries, userEvent, expect.element, and iframe-native DOM reads, then removal of the route tests, command, and config registration after coverage work. It also proposes updating only Operational validation contracts in spec.md and one focused timing measurement whose comparison limits are stated.
acceptanceCriteria: The plan's target is test intent: every in-scope behavior the Batch2 tests are intended to verify is covered by a specific existing or planned component assertion, without claiming production-route behaviors are covered.
The 20 Chromium cases have an explicit mapping to assertions and additions, and the four WebKit cases and production-route-only facts have an explicit disposition consistent with the clarified scope.

The plan uses public Vitest Browser Mode APIs against the test iframe, describes any component fixture and Next navigation mocking needed, and removes direct Playwright/BrowserCommand dependence from the target specs.
Deletion of route-specific tests, commands, and registrations is sequenced after component coverage; spec changes are limited to operational validation contracts.
Validation and the single timing measurement distinguish component coverage from production route coverage and do not claim a provider speedup from unlike workloads.
verification: The complete plan text was read from results/plan46/phase5/full-vitest-standard-plan.md.

The plan includes a 20-row case-to-assertion table, explicitly calls out excluded production-route-only behavior and WebKit cases, specifies the Vitest fixture/API strategy, lists ordered implementation ownership and completion conditions, and defines validation and one-run timing constraints.
No implementation has been performed at this plan checkpoint.
knownConstraints: This is a plan-validity checkpoint, not an implementation review or permission to widen the stated test purpose.
The user explicitly says faithful reproduction is not required when the test's intended checks can be verified.
The plan must not describe component fixture coverage as proof of production route, hydration, network, or device-profile behavior.
A single post-migration timing measurement is authorized; no repeat measurement is planned.
Review only the supplied non-secret plan context. Do not include credentials or request JEV to access local paths.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For any reason choice, report a case-specific finding, the affected plan section or acceptance criterion, the supplied evidence, and either a concrete correction or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details absent from the plan.

plan.instructions: Does this plan validly achieve the clarified goal of verifying the intended Batch2 test contracts with Vitest Browser Mode standard APIs, without requiring reproduction of production-route details? Return a probability distribution over all listed choices and identify concrete plan evidence for the selected choice.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The coverage mapping, scope boundary, migration sequence, and validation criteria are sufficiently clear and internally consistent for the clarified goal.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A stated requirement or planned exclusion conflicts with the user's clarified goal or the test behavior the plan intends to preserve; identify it and the correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A material prerequisite is missing; identify exactly what information is needed before the plan can proceed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan does not specify enough detail to establish how a material intended check will be preserved; identify the affected mapping and missing evidence or detail.
criteria.implementation_issue: The proposed Vitest fixture, APIs, migration order, or validation contains a concrete flaw; identify the location, evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan includes work beyond the clarified Batch2 test-intent goal or drops an in-scope behavior without justification; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the listed categories; identify its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied plan context cannot support a judgment; identify the missing context if possible.
